dedupe_keys.name: meteorological and load profile data set

description: Meteorological and load profile data set is a data set deposited in figshare.cput by its authors Ibukun Fajuke (Cape Peninsula University of Technology). 2021FEBEREC-STD-117 The data set consists of the hourly load demand, hourly solar irradiance and hourly wind speed of a community located in Northern part of Nigeria named Bara, Kirfi Local Government area of Bauchi state, Nigeria. Coverage: national (NG); the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 563531 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
